newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says no reserve requirements on FCDUs.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says no reserve requirements on FCDUs.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said he was not keen on imposing reserve requirements on foreign currency deposit units (FCDUs).
"If we will impose a reserve requirement, FCDUs in this country will no longer be competitive," Singson told reporters at the weekend in remarks were embargoed until Wednesday.
He said other Southeast Asian economies did not impose reserves for foreign currency deposits.

The statement came after the World Bank recommended that the bank require commercial banks to set aside reserves for foreign currency deposits to stem the growing foreign exchange loan portfolio of banks.
